claim: Patchline ships a fraud-resistant outcome-verification protocol for self-reported adopter incidents. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the fraud-resistant claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make fraud-resistant-outcome-verification-gate`.
